name: relay
description: Writes a verified, secret-free session resume state as a local owner-only file outside git tracking, and reloads it re-verified at session start.

interface.shortDescription: Write a verified resume state at session end, reload it re-verified at start.
interface.longDescription: Checks the draft state against branch, commit, pointed files, pull requests and tickets, refuses secrets, and writes an owner-only file outside git tracking. Reloads the state at the start of the next session and re-verifies it, listing every change since writing. Unreadable facts are reported as unknown.
defaultPrompt: Write the resume state for this session.
Reload the last resume state and re-verify it.
